profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company headquartered in Menlo Park, California, founded in 2004. According to its website, Meta builds AI models and tools for developers, offering access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and Meta Model API. The company describes its offerings as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, supporting both coding agents and AI development partnerships, with search grounding for live web access and Muse Image available on Meta Model API at $0.01 per image.

Meta's primary tracked AI product is Llama, an open-weight model family often self-hosted. The company also provides integrations and automation tools through multiple Model Context Protocol servers, including systems for Facebook and Instagram ads optimization, LLM comparison and image generation via FastMetal, access to an AI-in-research corpus of 12,400 papers through LivingMeta, and 3D avatar creation through Primeta.

Meta operates in a high-litigation environment, with at least 220 cases tracked in California alone. Current lawsuits include Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the Western District of Texas, Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the Northern District of California, and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc., also in the Northern District of California. Meta is a public company with reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 as of December 31, 2025, trading under ticker META.
